decisive_items: compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
Low clotting activity of factor X (52.2%; reference range, 77%-131%)
excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments scattered in the reticular dermis (von Kossa staining)
response.rationale: Compound heterozygous GGCX mutations with low factor X/prolonged PT and PXE-like skin calcification are diagnostic of GGCX deficiency; classic PXE and cutis laxa do not account for the coagulation defect, and GGCX-related disorder is less specific.

rejected.why: Same GGCX genetic evidence but less specific than GGCX deficiency; the phenotype and factor X deficiency support the specific enzyme deficiency.
Skin laxity is present, but yellowish papules, elastic-fiber calcification, and factor X deficiency are not explained by cutis laxa.
